pages: Good evening everyone, and welcome to the DemoChem Specialty Ltd. Q3 FY26 earnings conference call. Revenue for the quarter was Rs. 468 crore, up 14.1% year-on-year. EBITDA margin for the quarter was 16.2%.

Anil Mehta (CFO): For FY26 we continue to guide for revenue growth of 12-14% with EBITDA margins of around 18%. Our capex for FY26 will be approximately ₹250 crore, largely towards the new fluorination block at Dahej. Priya Nair (Analyst, Alpha Capital): Is the 18% margin target achievable given raw material pressure? Anil Mehta (CFO): Yes, we expect raw material costs to ease by Q1 FY27.
Rajiv Desai (MD): Revenue for FY26 grew 10.4% to ₹1,855 crore. EBITDA margin for the year was 16.6%. The Dahej block was commissioned in March.

Rajiv Desai (MD): Looking ahead, we are guiding for revenue growth of 15-18% in FY27 as the Dahej block ramps up. We expect EBITDA margins to recover to 18-19% this year. FY27 capex is planned at ₹200 crore. Karan Shah (Analyst, Gamma AMC): Will the 15-18% growth come mostly from volumes?

Rajiv Desai (MD): Revenue for the quarter grew 10.7% year-on-year. We remain confident of 15-18% revenue growth for FY27. However, given input cost inflation, we now expect EBITDA margin of about 17% for FY27.
Rajiv Desai (MD): Revenue grew 8.2% year-on-year to ₹489 crore. Given softer agrochemical demand, we are revising our FY27 revenue growth guidance to 12-14%.

Anil Mehta (CFO): We now expect EBITDA margin in the range of 16 to 17% for FY27. Mehul Shah (Analyst, Beta Securities): What PAT growth do you expect for FY27? Anil Mehta (CFO): We expect PAT growth of 10% for FY27, aided by lower interest costs in H2.
